description: This file defines the EmployeeDistributionByLocationModel class used for representing employee distribution data by location in a human resource management system. It includes metadata annotations for API documentation and uses traits for serialization, implementing the Normalizable interface. The class constructs an object based on LocationEmployeeCount data, configuring entity, filters, and attribute mappings.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocationModel
classes.description: A model class representing the distribution of employees by location for API responses; implements normalization and serialization traits.
